summary: This is a markdown documentation page explaining how to use a Project Setup component that helps developers quickly scaffold new projects. It demonstrates the component with a real Docker/PHP example and then walks through three different methods to get started: downloading a ZIP file, running a generated installation script, or manually creating files.

explanations.6: This imports the ProjectSetup component and two helper components (EmptyFolder and Guideline) from the site's component library so they can be used in this documentation.
explanations.12: This imports CSS styles specifically for this page, which are referenced later (like the headingIcon class used in the section headers).
explanations.20: The ProjectSetup component is being used here with a folderName prop that sets what the project directory will be called; this is a practical example showing how the component works.
explanations.42: Guideline is a special component that displays instructional text to users after they've set up their files—in this case, telling them how to start the Docker containers.
